in_PolicyID.description: ID of the insurance policy as mentioned on FNOL form

in_ClaimIXPDataJSON.description: Claim Information Containing all the details after document extraction

in_PolicyPDF.description: File containing insurance policy associated with the Claim

MimeType.description: The MIME type of the content, such as "application/json" or "image/png"
The MIME type of the content, such as "application/json" or "image/png"

out_isEligible.description: Whether Claim is eligible for assessment or not

out_isComplete.description: Whether property claim has all required information.

out_EligibilityChecksJSON.description: The eligibility check envelope. Every string in it is shown to a human reviewer, so labels must be human-readable, never payload field names. See contracts/check-envelope.md.

verdict.description: pass when all five checks pass; fail when the claim cannot proceed; attention when a human should decide.

headline.description: One line the reviewer can act on. States the reason, not the outcome.

summary.description: Reasoning across all five checks. Replaces the former out_EligibilityAnalysisSummary output.

checks.description: Exactly the five eligibility checks, in order, reported whether they pass or fail.

label.description: Sentence case, written for a claims reviewer.

status.description: warn when satisfied only with a caveat, e.g. a late filing with a stated justification.

verdict.description: The one-line result shown beside the label.

details.description: Supporting evidence for this check, up to 6 rows. Supply it for every check, passing ones included — a reviewer can expand a passing check to see what was compared.

out_ClaimDataJSON.description: Cleaned claim data without extraction metadata. Keeps every field for downstream analysis; the typed facts a database column needs are separate scalar outputs.

out_PolicyDataJSON.description: Policy Data converted from PDF to JSON. Keep every field and every clause from Policy file for downstream analysis.

out_ClaimantName.description: Claimant name. Own column, so plain text — no titles or annotations.

out_ClaimantEmail.description: The claimant's email address, lifted out of the raw extraction payload. A case expression cannot reach ClaimClaimant[0].EmailAddress.Value — one level of property access is the proven depth — so this scalar is the only thing that can address the claimant's notification (contracts/provided-processes.md). Empty string if the extraction did not carry one.

out_DateOfSubmission.description: ISO 8601 date the claim was submitted.

out_TotalClaimAmount.description: A number, not a formatted currency string. Strip the symbol and thousands separator.

messages.content: Check eligibility for claim: {{input.in_ClaimIXPDataJSON}}. Use {{input.in_PolicyID}} and {{input.in_PolicyPDF}}.
